title.en: Bukit Gombak Camp declared to be an Installation

title.vi: Trại Bukit Gombak được tuyên bố là Cơ sở Quân sự

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Road Traffic Act
(Chapter 276, Section 2 (1) (Paragraph (b) of Definition of Road))
Bukit Gombak Camp Declared to be An Installation
Decl 2
G.N. No. S 365/1993
REVISED EDITION 1994
(30th March 1994)
[10th September 1993]
The Minister for Communications has declared Bukit Gombak Camp to be an installation to which the Road Traffic Act applies.

titleTranslation.source: Bukit Gombak Camp declared to be an Installation
